pool.text: The church at Debre Gennet Medhane Alem was built in the city.
The Italian army established their fort near the Enda Eyesus church above Mekelle.
The Italian forces surrendered in January and retreated to their stronghold in Adigrat.
The Italian forces occupied the town of Mekelle during the month of November.
Shops, restaurants, and Hotel Amba Aradam with four rooms existed in the town.
The Mekelle municipality was officially founded during the urban development phase.
Mekelle was held by the Woyane rebellion leaders against the Haile Selassie government.
The atse Yohannes Elementary School was established in the city of Mekelle.
The atse Yohannes Secondary School was established in the city of Mekelle.
The master plan for the urban development of Mekelle was issued.
Fifty to sixty people died every day in seven hunger camps in Mekelle.
The TPLF released 1,800 political prisoners from the Mekelle prison in a raid.
Mekelle was occupied by the TPLF after the government position in Tigray collapsed.
The population of Mekelle reached 97,000 inhabitants with mostly Tigrinya-speakers.
The Eritrean Air Force bombed Ayder School in Mekelle killing twelve people.
The UNMEE headquarters was established in Mekelle following the Eritrean-Ethiopian War.
A riot broke out between Ethiopian Orthodox and Adventist worshippers in a stadium.
Addis Alem Balema represented the Mekelle special zone in the House of Peoples' Representatives.
The Abergelle Slaughterhouse began its operations in Mekelle funded by Dejenna Endowment.
Witnesses stated that artillery shelling had taken place in Mekelle before 28 November.
